title: LaTeX output of a symbol named with a double underscore shows a subscript instead of a superscript
body:
### What I did

```python
from sympy import Symbol, latex
x2 = Symbol('x__2')
print(latex(x2))
```

### What I got

```
x_{2}
```

### What I expected

`x^{2}`. The docs say a double underscore in a symbol name marks a superscript (like `^`), and this used to work. `pprint` of the same symbol also prints `x₂` now.
